summary: Builds a formatted string plus an appended suffix into a bounded destination buffer. When the suffix a2 is non-null and non-empty, the format string a1 is formatted into a local buffer via StringFormatWrapper, the suffix is appended, the combined text is copied into a3 with a bounded copy of a4 - 1 bytes via sub_587DD0, and a null terminator is forced at a3[a4 - 1]; the function returns 1. Otherwise the destination a3 is cleared to an empty string and the function returns 0.

operations.description: Branch on the suffix a2 being non-null and non-empty (strlen(a2) != 0); the else path clears the destination.
Call StringFormatWrapper(a1, v5, 512) to format the format string into the 512-byte local scratch buffer.
Append the suffix a2 to the formatted text in the scratch buffer (strcat).
Call sub_587DD0(a3, v5, a4 - 1) to copy the combined text into the destination with a maximum length of a4 - 1 bytes.
Force a null terminator at the last destination slot a3[a4 - 1].
Return 1 on the successful build-and-copy path.
On the empty-suffix path, clear the destination's first byte (*a3 = 0).
Return 0 when no suffix was supplied.
